findings.evidence: TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/CliffordAlgebra/PinAction.lean:134 `theorem neg_one_mem_spinGroup_of_isUnit (Q : QuadraticForm R M) (v : M) (hvQ : IsUnit (Q v))` vs Kernel.lean:300-302 with `[Field K] [Nontrivial M] (hQ : Q.Nondegenerate)`.
findings.fix: Rename this one `neg_one_mem_spinGroup_of_nondegenerate` (its hypothesis is `hQ`), leaving `neg_one_mem_spinGroup_of_isUnit` as is; update the use at line 319.
findings.issue: `neg_one_mem_spinGroup` takes the unqualified name but is the restricted version (`Field K`, `Nontrivial M`, `Q.Nondegenerate`), while the strictly more general lemma over a `CommRing` carries the qualified name `neg_one_mem_spinGroup_of_isUnit`. The short name advertises the general statement and delivers the special case.

findings.evidence: Naming conventions, Logic dictionary: `∃` → `exists`. Repo precedent for the same shape in a private helper: TauCeti/Algebra/AlgebraicGroup/GeneralLinear/Coordinate/HopfAlgebra.lean:307 `private theorem exists_eq_mul_inverse_algebraMap_pow`.
findings.fix: Prefix all three with `exists_` (`exists_eq_algebraMap_of_contractLeft_eq_zero`, etc.). `eq_algebraMap_of_all_contractLeft_eq_zero` at 190 is a genuine equality and is correct as is.
findings.issue: `eq_algebraMap_of_contractLeft_eq_zero` (220), `eq_algebraMap_of_mem_even_of_commute` (235) and `coe_eq_algebraMap_of_mem_ker_spinToOrthogonal` (270) all conclude `∃ r, … = algebraMap K _ r`, but the names claim an equality; the naming dictionary maps `∃` to `exists`.

findings.evidence: `grep -rl Projector Mathlib` returns no files; Mathlib uses `proj`/`linearProj` (e.g. `LinearMap.proj`, `Submodule.linearProjOfIsCompl`).
findings.fix: Rename to `basis_exteriorAlgebra_singleton_eq_ι` (or similar naming the conclusion) and `coordinateProj`/`exteriorCoordProj`.
findings.issue: `basis_singleton` is an exterior-algebra statement (`b.ExteriorAlgebra {i} = ExteriorAlgebra.ι K (b i)`) living in the `TauCeti.CliffordAlgebra` namespace under a name that mentions neither the algebra nor the conclusion; `coordinateProjector` (112) uses "Projector", a term absent from Mathlib.

summary: The canonical `-1` element is named `negOneSpin` with a type-name suffix instead of following the repo's own `Gamma0.negOne`/`Gamma0.coe_negOne` precedent and Mathlib's `spinGroup` namespace, the unqualified `neg_one_mem_spinGroup` is given to the strictly less general of the two membership lemmas, and three existential lemmas are named `eq_algebraMap_…`. No notation is introduced.
